actual_declarations.name: Soft bra
actual_declarations.cloSource: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2010, Informative Appendix B, Table B2 'Garment Insulation', Underwear: 'Bra' 0.01. Read from the standard's own text, not from a secondary table. This is the same table the entries below cite as 55-2013 Table 5.2.2.2B; it moved from the appendix into the body of the standard between editions.
actual_declarations.formalitySource: AUTHORED. research/wardrobe-system.md §6 records that no literature supports a formality ladder. 1 is the floor because nothing about a foundation garment is a statement — 9.8's whole requirement is that it goes unnoticed.
actual_declarations.source: AUTHORED BY THIS REPO, and authored blind — docs/BRIEF.md records that the 638 supplied reference images contain no foundation layer at all. Generated by tools/figure-pipeline/build_figure.py --foundation as a conformal shell over the MPFB2 basemesh (CC0): a region of the figure's own skin, offset 3 mm along its normals and tapered to 0.8 mm at the hem. No third-party asset, and no texture.

actual_declarations.name: Sleeveless vest
actual_declarations.cloSource: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2010, Informative Appendix B, Table B2, Underwear: 'T-shirt' 0.08. ⚠️ NEAREST ROW, FLAGGED: the table has no sleeveless undershirt. A sleeveless garment insulates less than the sleeved row quoted, and the reduction is NOT in the table, so none is applied — an over-estimate from a real row beats a plausible number from nowhere. Dresser (9.11) should read this as an upper bound.
actual_declarations.source: AUTHORED BY THIS REPO, as foundation_bra. Conflicts with foundation_bra by construction — both are FOUNDATION/TORSO — because they are alternatives, not layers.

actual_declarations.name: Briefs
actual_declarations.cloSource: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2010, Informative Appendix B, Table B2, Underwear: 'Panties' 0.03.
actual_declarations.source: AUTHORED BY THIS REPO, as foundation_bra.

actual_declarations.name: Boxer brief
actual_declarations.cloSource: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2010, Informative Appendix B, Table B2, Underwear: "Men's briefs" 0.04. ⚠️ NEAREST ROW, FLAGGED: the table has no boxer brief, and this garment's legs reach mid-thigh where a brief's do not. Quoted unmodified rather than adjusted, for the reason given on foundation_vest.
actual_declarations.source: AUTHORED BY THIS REPO, as foundation_bra. Claims LEGS as well as HIPS because its hem is at mid-thigh; that is what stops a future hosiery-layer garment from being told it is compatible when it is not.

actual_declarations.name: Casual suit
actual_declarations.cloSource: ASHRAE 55-2013 Table 5.2.2.2B, additive per §5.2.2.2(c): long-sleeve dress shirt 0.25 + trousers, thin 0.15. The table has no one-piece casual suit; this is the sum of its two parts, and the sum is what the standard says to do.
actual_declarations.formalitySource: AUTHORED. research/wardrobe-system.md §6 records that no literature supports a formality ladder; the number is a design choice and is marked as one.
